title: Proof-Carrying Claims and Adversarial Review
subtitle: Selected claims and artifacts should move through proof-carrying, justification-carrying, or adversarial-review envelopes that record… verifier or tribunal result, dissent, limitations, failed attempts, required actions, residuals, and ledger effects.

display.problem: High-value claims and high-risk artifacts need a governed verification path… treatment without laundering failed, mismatched, or contested evidence into support.
display.insufficient: Neural generation, one-pass self-critique, and informal review can produce plausible… evidence dossier, dissent, failed attempts, verdict constraints, or downgrade routes.

mechanism.label: Freeze target claim artifact
mechanism.detail: Freeze target claim or artifact identity, exact… horizon, and change triggers before route outcomes.

mechanism.label: Target declare eligible ineligible
mechanism.detail: Classify the target and declare eligible, ineligible… review, accountable-human adjudication, downgrade, block, or abstention.

mechanism.label: Select prospectively justified
mechanism.detail: Select a prospectively justified route or route… route after seeing a favorable result.

mechanism.label: Source prose normalized claim
mechanism.detail: Bind source prose, normalized claim, formal target… treating formal syntax as semantic equivalence.

failures: Certified delusion pairs a false, unsupported… valid-looking artifact or verdict.

proof_targets: A target-specific verification lifecycle preserves exact claim… preventing direct support assignment or external effects.
